card.name: Word endings in -ability, -actions, limit
card.fires_on: The last piece of a longer noun, such as -ability, -actions, -itation, or the word 'limit' or 'requirements' after a dose or nutrient term, in drug-label text.

modes.label: Ending of a long word
modes.description: The closing piece of a word split into parts, like -ability, -actions, -itation, -icated.
modes.example: Inter<<actions>> between hormonal contraceptives and other drugs

modes.label: Limit or requirements after a dose term
modes.description: The noun 'limit' or 'requirements' following dosage, tolerable, or amino acid.
modes.example: The maximum dosage<< limit>> within the recommended dosage range must be individual

card.writes: It seems to lower words about what is allowed or permitted, such as 'permissible' and 'restrictions'.
card.plain: It fires on the end of words like interactions or irritability and on 'limit' after dosage, and it holds back words like 'allowed'.
